form.message: Project Fulcrum — six remaining DEV planning inputs before comparison pricing. ACR EU paired-artifact acceptance, Entra exception, LRS pin, secretless profile, scope, monitoring ownership and soft budget are already settled and are not being reconfirmed. Assumed Corp policies—not tenant-verified; DEV Architecture-only. The accepted source denies project VPN/P2S gateways. Select the private client pattern and explicitly adopt or revise the proposed usage/recovery assumptions below. No answer approves final SKUs, VNet design, Gate 2, spending or Azure access.

dev_client_access_profile.title: Private DEV client and runner origins
dev_client_access_profile.description: Select the access pattern to investigate and price. The ephemeral option means controlled VNet-hosted development/test clients and runners, recreated for sessions; it does not promise direct physical-phone ingress. Persistent access is optional, not imposed. Direct mobile access needs separate technical feasibility under the unchanged private API and no-project-VPN Corp floor. This is not final SKU/topology approval.
enum: Direct physical mobile-device access is required

dev_compute_demand_profile.title: Backend sizing envelope for comparison pricing
dev_compute_demand_profile.description: Proposed assumption: one container, 512 MiB steady/768 MiB peak application memory with at least 40% platform memory headroom; 20 RPS for a 10-minute concentrated peak; 20,000 requests per active day, 22 active days/month; 730 billed host hours/month. The settled 10–100 concurrency range and under-2-second planning objective remain. This is sizing evidence for pricing, not measured performance or an approved SKU. Use custom text in this field to supply a different envelope or an explicit unknown.
enum: Adopt the proposed compute planning envelope

dev_data_meter_profile.title: Data, diagnostics and private-traffic pricing assumptions
dev_data_meter_profile.description: Proposed monthly profile: Cosmos 10 GB/20 million RU, 1,000 RU/s peak, one database/three containers/2 KiB items; Hot Blob 20 GB live +10 GB protected versions/deletions +0.5 GB change feed, 100,000 reads/10,000 writes/10,000 lists, maximum object 10 MiB; ACR 10 GB stored images; one combined 1 GB sanitized workspace ingestion with the settled 30-day retention; four metric alert rules/four series and one 5-minute log alert; 1 million private DNS queries. Per private endpoint towards/from service GB: API 20/50, Cosmos 5/20, Blob 10/50, ACR 5/10. One monthly 10 GB Cosmos +20 GB Blob restore exercise; flat six-month scenario, not a growth forecast. Supporting access meters will be added for the selected path. No inherited central DNS/policy resource is silently treated as project-deployed or free. Full profile is saved alongside this form. Use custom text here for changed quantities or explicit unknowns.
enum: Adopt the proposed data and meter planning profile

dev_access_provisioned_hours_per_month.title: Billable private DEV access hours per month
dev_access_provisioned_hours_per_month.description: Supply provisioned hours, including idle time: for example 80 for bounded sessions with billable access resources deleted afterward, or 730 for persistent access. Deallocating a VM alone does not stop Bastion/NAT/public-IP/disk billing. A value greater than zero and no greater than 744 is required for the new required path. This does not authorize deployment or select infrastructure.

dev_recovery_failure_coverage.title: Failure coverage of the existing 4-hour RTO / 1-hour RPO
dev_recovery_failure_coverage.description: LRS and Sweden Central-only application data/backups cannot guarantee recovery from permanent regional loss. Clarify whether the existing objectives apply to recoverable logical/deletion/application faults, while regional-outage recovery remains provider-dependent. Neither answer relaxes LRS, residency or security. If permanent regional loss is included, the conflict goes to the Requirements owner; Architecture will not silently redefine the targets.
enum: Recoverable logical/deletion/application faults; regional recovery is provider-dependent
The 4-hour/1-hour targets must include permanent regional loss

dev_backup_retention_profile.title: Cosmos and Blob application-recovery retention
dev_backup_retention_profile.description: Choose a planning retention profile for application recovery, independently of the already settled 30-day sanitized diagnostics. Proposed seven-day protection uses supported Cosmos continuous backup and eligible Blob PITR/versioning/change feed/soft delete. Thirty days is an alternative with corresponding protected-data and backup meters; supporting soft-delete retention must exceed Blob PITR retention. Use custom text here for another requirement; capability and costs still need verification.

answers.industry: Nonprofit community support for vulnerable individuals and families; volunteer-led experiences and support
answers.system_description: Infrastructure-only hosting platform and cloud services for a secure, intuitive, mobile-first Volunteer engagement MVP, including support for a containerized backend. All application development is handled by another team and is out of scope.
answers.business_objective: Reduce manual coordination and administrative overhead; improve Volunteer engagement and matching, opportunity discovery, assignments, approvals, tracking, reporting, visibility and communication; accelerate assignments and grow without proportional administration.
infrastructure_scope: Hosting support for a containerized backend; backend code excluded
Notification platform capabilities, with channels still to evaluate
Store anonymous resulting documentation in this repository
application_scope_exclusions: Detailed business workflow, escalation and reporting implementation
answers.technology_evaluation_constraints: Candidates are not mandatory selections. Evaluate alternatives for suitability, security, simplicity, maintainability, scale and cost within limited nonprofit budgets; challenge complexity and avoid overengineering.
answers.design_preferences_not_decisions: Prefer managed services and a modular monolith; no microservices absent clear justification.
answers.data_processing_constraints: Personal Volunteer information and sensitive organizational activity may be processed. Beneficiary data is not assumed. Never use real personal information in development or testing; fictional sample data only.
security_privacy_requirements: Secure authentication and role-based access control
Encryption in transit and at rest
compliance: GDPR required for Production. MVP must be GDPR-aligned; the supplied brief says MVP does not have to be compliant. This release distinction does not waive applicable legal duties or mandatory security/privacy controls. Do not certify compliance.
anonymity_requirements: Anonymous generated source, documentation, commits, issues, pull requests, test data, infrastructure-as-code and artifacts
No customer/nonprofit or technology-partner names, individual names, real domains, organizational identifiers, correspondence or real beneficiary/Volunteer information
Use only generic party labels: The Organization, Technology Contributors, Volunteers, Coordinators, Administrators, Project Stakeholders
Do not request real names, personal emails, domains or identities during discovery
Do not publish repository remote URLs or account identities in project documentation
Author attribution uses agent role only; no people
answers.budget_limit: Planning target — optimize and highlight overruns
answers.recovery_profile: Standard — recover within 4 hours; up to 1 hour of data loss
answers.performance_target: Typical API responses under 2 seconds — planning goal to validate
answers.private_client_access: A new secure remote-access path is needed
answers.authentication_requirement: Employees plus external Volunteers — fictional dev accounts
answers.monitoring_access_scope: An existing platform/team handles monitoring access
answers.monitoring_network_requirement: Authenticated public monitoring permitted if policy allows
answers.non_relational_store: Cosmos DB — preferred primary document store
notification_channels: Mobile push capability — fictional/dev testing only
Dev simulation only — no outbound delivery

residency_requirement.workload: Sweden Central only for workload compute, application data, storage and backups; retain the existing single-region boundary for non-Entra services, monitoring and other dependencies, except the narrow ACR registry-artifact behavior explicitly accepted below.
residency_requirement.microsoft_entra_identity_exception: Accept Microsoft Entra identity's documented European customer data storage and processing behavior at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/fundamentals/data-storage-eu, including its documented qualifications and limited temporary or permanent transfers. Most customer data within the EU Data Boundary is not an absolute no-EU-egress guarantee.
residency_requirement.applicability_prerequisite: Architecture must verify tenant creation/provisioning and exact identity-product coverage for workforce and external Volunteer sign-in, including Entra External ID external-tenant applicability; no applicable tenant or deployed commitment is verified here.
residency_requirement.excluded_permissions: No general global-service, monitoring, storage or other integrated-service exception beyond the explicitly accepted ACR registry-artifact behavior; no automatic permission for optional multitenant collaboration, Application Proxy or other optional cross-boundary features; no law, effective-policy or security-baseline waiver. No optional customer-configured ACR geo-replication, arbitrary replicas or other-service paired-region storage is authorized.
residency_requirement.acceptance_scope: Project Stakeholders accept the existing narrow Entra exception as meeting their project GDPR requirements; that acceptance is unchanged. The additional DEV-only ACR acceptance covers only the documented Microsoft-managed paired-region storage of container images and registry artifacts within the EU residency boundary. Neither acceptance is independent certification, blanket GDPR compliance assurance, architecture approval or Azure read/write, spend, Production or deployment authority; no new review allowance or regional disaster-recovery guarantee is granted.
residency_requirement.acr_registry_artifact_exception: Accept the documented Microsoft-managed ACR paired-region storage behavior within the EU residency boundary for container images and registry artifacts only, per https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/container-registry/container-registry-storage. Sweden Central remains the registry creation/workload region; its documented Sweden South pair lies within the accepted EU boundary. Actual replication and regional recovery remain unverified. Workload compute, application data, Blob, backups, monitoring, non-ACR dependencies and the existing Entra exception remain unchanged.

answers.notification_delivery_scope: Simulation-only MVP — defer email/push transports, retain functional channel intent
messaging_events: None — no separate messaging/event service required
supporting_services: Azure Monitor + Application Insights + Log Analytics — preferred diagnostics products
Azure Container Registry — preferred container image registry
answers.sku_app_service: No SKU preference — Architect choose least-cost suitable tier meeting captured requirements
answers.sku_nosql: No SKU preference — Architect choose least-cost suitable tier meeting captured requirements
answers.sku_storage_repl: LRS — explicit locally redundant replication pin
answers.sku_env_override: No dev-specific SKU override — apply these preferences to dev only
answers.dev_secret_certificate_profile: managed identities plus platform-provided HTTPS can cover every required dev connection
